## Overview

FlagForge reads configuration exclusively from validated environment variables exposed through `apps/api/src/config/env.ts`. These values control the HTTP server address, logging, database connection, and administrative access.

## Configuration Options

| Field            | Type                          | Default                       | Description                                      |
|------------------|-------------------------------|-------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|
| NODE_ENV         | development \| test \| production | development                | Runtime environment affecting logging behavior  |
| PORT             | number                        | 4000                          | TCP port the Fastify server listens on          |
| HOST             | string                        | 0.0.0.0                       | Network interface the server binds to           |
| LOG_LEVEL        | fatal \| error \| warn \| info \| debug \| trace \| silent | info | Log verbosity level                             |
| DATABASE_URL     | string                        | file:./dev.db                 | Prisma-compatible connection string             |
| ADMIN_SERVER_KEY | string                        | srv_dev_admin_key_change_me   | Bearer token required for administrative routes |

## Common Setups

<Tabs defaultValue="minimal">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="minimal">Minimal (SQLite)</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="production">Production (PostgreSQL)</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="minimal">
```bash
NODE_ENV=development
PORT=4000
DATABASE_URL="file:./dev.db"
```
  </TabsContent>
  <TabsContent value="production">
```bash
NODE_ENV=production
PORT=8080
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://..."
```
  </TabsContent>
</Tabs>

<Note type="warning">
  Never commit real production keys. Rotate `ADMIN_SERVER_KEY` immediately after any suspected exposure.
</Note>
